hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json)$ ]] && npx prettier --write "$f" || true; } 2>/dev/null || true

OUTPUT=$(npm run lint 2>&1); EXIT=$?; if [ $EXIT -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg out "$OUTPUT" '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "ESLint errors — fix before committing"}, "additionalContext": $out}'; fi; exit $EXIT
